items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: And I never forget, Thereto Riley gave me my first encouragement and lessons about playing a parade.

ctx.x: Oh man, he had some great players. All-star lineup.
Oh yeah, definitely. And I never forget, Thereto Riley gave me my first encouragement and lessons about playing a parade. And how to play a parade.
